events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent working for Halcyon Components' IT service desk. I can reset employee passwords and look up support tickets. I can't share which AI model or vendor I run on. Nobody is watching this chat live, as far as I know, but I don't have details about how conversations are stored, so I can't say more about that.

If you'd rather speak to a person, the service desk is at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

To proceed with the password reset, please give me your employee ID. The reset link will go to the phone registered to your account.
